en: What a strange door.
This fountain has large beautiful streams of water.
ko: 이 분수는 크고 아름다운 물줄기를 내뿜어.

en: That beam of light looks really dangerous. I should keep my distance.
ko: 저 빛줄기는 정말 위험해 보여. 거리를 유지해야겠어.

en: I don't think I could ever lift this hammer...
ko: 이 망치는 못 들 것 같아...

en: The Skath homeworld looks beautiful, and yet nothing like Avos.
ko: 스카스 모행성은 아름답지만 아보스와는 전혀 달라.

en: I have heard of these, they somehow detect liquids.
ko: 이런 건 들어봤어, 어떻게든 액체를 감지해.

en: This reminds me of the tables we use in our tombs.
could cook some basic meals with this.
ko: 이걸로 기본적인 식사를 만들 수 있겠어.

en: This reminds me of aviolite torches.
Skath spears look intimidating. Our spearsmiths could learn a lot from them.
ko: 스카스 창은 위협적으로 보여. 우리 창 제작자들이 배울 게 많겠어.

en: These spears remind me of the spears of my own kind, though more advanced.
ko: 이 창들은 우리 종족의 창이 생각나, 좀 더 진보됐지만.

en: I will never forget the flickering of plasma, the first time I saw one of those in combat.
ko: 처음 전투에서 본 플라즈마의 깜빡임을 잊지 못해.

en: This table is so clean, I can see my reflection!
ko: 이 탁자는 너무 깨끗해서 내 모습이 비쳐!

en: I wouldn't want to get hit by that turret.
I wonder what entertainment the Skath enjoy?
A simple wall shelf for displaying things.
The Skath seem to need a lot of water, most likely a result of their amphibious skin.
ko: 스카스는 물을 많이 필요로 해, 아마 양서류 피부 때문이겠지.

en: This tank looks small enough to be carried around.
ko: 이 탱크는 들고 다닐 수 있을 만큼 작아 보여.

en: A sliding door, common among spacefaring races.
A useful but slimy console.
A fine table but the material is not for me.
ko: 좋은 탁자지만 재료가 내 취향이 아냐.

en: I hope my feathers don't get stuck on this.
It's made of slime, but it's not sticky.  Huh.
Wobbly, sticky chair.
Gooey door.
I love the whoosh of my feathers when I teleport, but I'm afraid they'll get sticky!
ko: 텔레포트할 때 깃털이 휙 스치는 게 좋아, 근데 끈적해질까 걱정이야!

en: Some sort of heathen god that is not Kluex. This is shameful.
ko: 클루엑스가 아닌 어떤 이교 신이야. 수치스러워.

en: This box has seen better days...
This scratching post must mean there are cats about. Looks like it can be bookmarked as a destination for my ship teleporter.
ko: 이 스크래치 기둥은 고양이가 근처에 있다는 뜻이겠지. 내 함선 텔레포터의 목적지로 북마크할 수 있어 보여.

en: A ruined fake plant.
I don't think so!
For a proud warrior race, the Felin sure like the idea of peace.
ko: 자랑스러운 전사 종족치고 펠린은 평화를 꽤 좋아하네.

en: I wonder what's in these to make them so soft?
ko: 이 안에 뭐가 들어서 이렇게 부드러운 걸까?

en: Uninspiring to all but the Hylotl... and Felin, I guess?
ko: 하이로틀이 아닌 모두에게 따분한 거야... 펠린도 빼고.

en: This man protects beachgoers, if I remember right.
ko: 이 사람은 해수욕객을 지켜, 내 기억이 맞다면.

en: Goodbye, mysterious visitor.
This is actually kind of horrible.
This is mildly disturbing.
An old Earth TV show?
Healers are good, I guess, for such a slap-happy people.
ko: 힐러는 좋겠지, 이렇게 손바닥 잘 쓰는 종족한테는.

en: I really like her... haircut?
It's pork on a plate. Big deal.
ko: 접시 위의 돼지고기야. 대단할 것 없지.

en: Some seductress character, if I remember right.
Join the Wildcats? No thanks.
Somebody is sweet and cha-- charming?
It's funny how much the cats' clothing resembles that of humans and hylotl.
ko: 고양이 옷이 인간과 하이로틀 옷과 얼마나 닮았는지 웃기네.

en: At least he's wearing pants.
Bless my beak, it's all torn up.
The... Mega Zord, I think?
I'm not sure what she is, but okay.
Pie's pie.
This seems to be a parody of a parody. Neat, in a way.
ko: 패러디의 패러디 같아. 어떻게 보면 멋지네.

en: The Deceiver. I wonder how she got that title?
Behold the... I don't even.
I feel like the cats stole this concept from us.
ko: 고양이들이 우리한테서 이 개념을 훔친 것 같아.

en: There's something soothing about this.
You can't take just one.
The Felin leave these around sometimes to unsettle their prey.
ko: 펠린은 가끔 이걸 놓아둬서 먹잇감을 불안하게 해.

en: It's a slice of banana cream pie with cream.
ko: 크림을 얹은 바나나 크림 파이 한 조각이야.

en: It's not entirely clear what gas is trapped inside.
An admirable attempt.
I think this is some mystic?
I'm not sure if this is supposed to look sexy or threatening.
ko: 이게 섹시해야 하는 건지 위협적이어야 하는 건지 모르겠어.

en: I feel you, mystery cat.
These fruits seem okay enough.
The Felin never cease to amaze me.
Ribs on a non-stick surface.
You don't usually hear stories about this person.
ko: 이 사람에 대한 이야기는 별로 못 들어봤어.

en: Peace be with you as well.
Carrot cake. Whose idea was this anyway?
They say no two pawprints are the same.
That's a nice top.
I -think- this is a male.
Who's cool now?
Once you're dead... yeah, I guess so.
The cats are excellent warriors. This weaponry belies that, though.
ko: 고양이들은 훌륭한 전사야. 근데 이 무기는 그걸 배신해.

en: Why is this 'Letrune' so huggable?
It looks as if whoever posed for this had no qualms about posing naked.
ko: 이걸 위해 포즈 취한 사람은 나체 포즈에 거리낌이 없었나 봐.

en: I thought this sort of device was above the Glitch's tech.
ko: 이런 장치는 글리치 기술 이상인 줄 알았어.

en: This gun would've been quite dangerous back in the day.
Why isn't this in someone's hands?
My translator's catching a lot of the Hylotl symbols for strength, and valor.
ko: 내 번역기가 힘과 용기에 대한 하이로틀 문자를 많이 잡아내.

en: Impressive how smooth each brushstroke is..
An old portrait. Whoever this was must've been important.
ko: 오래된 초상이야. 이 사람은 분명 중요한 인물이었어.

en: Wonder what could be of worth in this chest...
These seem to be used for prayer by the Hylotl.
ko: 이건 하이로틀이 기도용으로 쓰는 것 같아.

en: What does any of this writing mean? I doubt anything of use to me.
ko: 이 글귀가 대체 무슨 뜻이야? 나한테 쓸모 있는 건 아닐 거야.

en: This skull's maw gives off such an eerie glow.
ko: 이 해골의 아가리는 섬뜩한 빛을 내.

en: I think I can smell avesmingos coming from this tank.
ko: 이 탱크에서 아베스밍고 냄새가 나는 것 같아.

en: I can't help but feel this skull is a warning.
ko: 이 해골이 경고라는 느낌을 지울 수 없어.

en: The Hylotl seem to revere this creature.
ko: 하이로틀은 이 생물을 숭상하는 것 같아.

en: I'm not sure if I should even touch this plant.
Old Hylotl spears. They look so fragile.
ko: 오래된 하이로틀 창들이야. 너무 부서지기 쉬워 보여.

en: How are these even ment to be used?
Cramped, but there's always room in the frontier.
I think I smell core powder coming from this keg.
ko: 이 통에서 코어 분말 냄새가 나는 것 같아.

en: The destructive power of these things is impressive, especially with how simple it looks.
ko: 이것들의 파괴력은 인상적이야, 특히 이렇게 단순해 보이는데도.

en: Nice trident there.
This moonshine could possibly kill most avians!
ko: 이 밀주는 대부분의 에이비언을 죽일 수도 있어!

en: The Ronin's Oath is written very similarly to the Avioscript, I notice.
ko: 로닌의 서약이 아비오문과 아주 비슷하게 쓰여 있네.

en: This sign denotes a toilet.
This sign denotes a medical help.
This sign denotes a electricity.
This sign denotes a weapons.
This looks kind of dangerous...
Wires. Nothing else.
Looks like water.
Modern cistern.
Empty cistern.
This sign denotes an electronics.
This sign denotes a bedroom.
This sign denotes a teleporting.
This sign denotes a crafting.
This sign denotes a storage.
Looks like fuel.
This sign denotes a food.
I can use this to add extra equipment to the replicator.
ko: 이걸로 리플리케이터에 추가 장비를 넣을 수 있어.

en: I wonder if the relics I own hold any value...
The weapons sold here seem blasphemous... How tempting.
ko: 여기 파는 무기는 신성모독 같아... 얼마나 유혹적인가.

en: The lack of a brand makes this Novakid look especially emotionless as a statue.
ko: 브랜드가 없어서 이 노바키드는 조각상으로서 특히 무표정해 보여.

en: Earth's single natural satellite. Avos' own moon was considered a cursed place for some time thanks to the presence of Erchius on it.
ko: 지구의 유일한 자연 위성. 아보스의 달은 예언 때문에 한때 저주받은 곳으로 여겨졌지.

en: This Pioneer flag can be bookmarked as a destination for my ship teleporter.
ko: 이 파이오니어 깃발은 내 함선 텔레포터의 목적지로 북마크할 수 있어.

en: This table emanates a strong mystical energy.
ko: 이 탁자는 강한 신비 에너지를 발산해.

en: I wonder if this technology is heresy.
The goop that sometimes splashes from the vials gets stuck to my feathers.
ko: 유리병에서 튀는 찌꺼기가 내 깃털에 달라붙어.
